requirement_text: Employer and agency registration shall be facilitated.
user_story: As an employer or agency, I want to register on the platform, so that I can use its services.
technical_task: Provide registration for employers and agencies.
acceptance_criteria: Given the registration page, when an employer registers, then an employer account is created.
Given the registration page, when an agency registers, then an agency account is created.

requirement_text: THEN TSA display content shall be updated according to TSA display strategy earliest 200 milliseconds before passing the sign and no later than the EV is passing the sign.
user_story: As a driver, I want the TSA display updated according to the TSA display strategy at the earliest 200 milliseconds before I pass the sign and no later than when the EV passes it, so that the sign information is current.
technical_task: Update the TSA display content per the TSA display strategy between 200 milliseconds before the sign is passed and the moment the EV passes the sign.
acceptance_criteria: Given the EV approaches a sign, when 200 milliseconds remain before passing it, then the TSA display may be updated according to the TSA display strategy.
Given the EV passes the sign, when it passes, then the TSA display has already been updated.
rationale: Role assumed: driver. The leading "THEN" refers to a condition not shown.

requirement_text: The force-travel-characteristic brings the haptic characteristic closer by Chords-of-pieces as in Fig. F-1, F-2, F-3 and F-4 represented on.
rationale: The sentence describes a characteristic through figures that are not given and states no testable behaviour.
clarification_questions: What does "brings the haptic characteristic closer by Chords-of-pieces" require the system to do?
What do the referenced figures F-1 to F-4 show?

requirement_text: MIDs should be considered private sensitive information.
requirement_text_raw: MIDs should be considered private  sensitive information.
user_story: As a privacy officer, I want MIDs treated as private sensitive information, so that they are protected accordingly.
technical_task: Classify MIDs as private sensitive information and apply the handling rules for such information.
acceptance_criteria: Given a MID, when it is stored or shown, then it is handled as private sensitive information.
Given a user without permission to see private sensitive information, when the user requests a MID, then it is not shown.
rationale: Role assumed: privacy officer. "Should" makes this a recommendation; the handling rules are not listed.

requirement_text: Managers shall be able to confirm when tasks have been completed.
user_story: As a manager, I want to confirm when tasks have been completed, so that completion is recorded.
technical_task: Offer a confirmation action for completed tasks to managers.
acceptance_criteria: Given a task that has been completed, when a manager confirms it, then the task is marked as confirmed.
Given a user who is not a manager, when the user tries to confirm a task, then it is not confirmed.

requirement_text: The product must be able to interface with any HTML browser. The product shall transmit data between the user and the product without problems. The product shall display HTML properly in 80% of all HTML browsers tested (minimum is to test 8 browsers).
requirement_text_raw: The product must be able to interface with any HTML browser.  The product shall transmit data between the user and the product without problems. The product shall display HTML properly in 80\% of all HTML browsers tested (minimum is to test 8 browsers).'
user_story: As a user, I want the product to work with any HTML browser, transmit data without problems and display HTML properly in 80% of the browsers tested, so that I can use my browser.
technical_task: Test the product in at least 8 HTML browsers and make sure it displays HTML properly in 80% of the browsers tested while transmitting data without problems.
acceptance_criteria: Given at least 8 HTML browsers, when the product is tested in them, then it displays HTML properly in 80% of them.
Given a browser used with the product, when data is transmitted between the user and the product, then it is transmitted without problems.

requirement_text: User shall ensure that when deploying a new version of an app including a shared dataset type, only dataset instances created by that app start using the new code.
user_story: As an app developer, I want only the dataset instances created by my app to start using the new code when I deploy a new app version with a shared dataset type, so that other apps' datasets are not affected.
technical_task: On deployment of a new app version that includes a shared dataset type, switch only the dataset instances created by that app to the new code.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new version of an app with a shared dataset type is deployed, when deployment completes, then dataset instances created by that app use the new code.
Given dataset instances created by other apps, when the new version is deployed, then they do not start using the new code.
rationale: Role assumed: app developer; the requirement says user.

requirement_text: System shall confirm submission of leave request.
user_story: As an employee, I want confirmation that my leave request was submitted, so that I know it was received.
technical_task: Show a confirmation after a leave request is submitted.
acceptance_criteria: Given a leave request is submitted, when submission completes, then a confirmation is shown.
Given a leave request that fails to submit, when it ends, then no confirmation of submission is shown.

requirement_text: The client will send a GET request to the Web API with the question as a URL parameter.
user_story: As a client developer, I want to send a GET request to the Web API with the question as a URL parameter, so that I can ask a question programmatically.
technical_task: Accept a GET request to the Web API that carries the question as a URL parameter.
acceptance_criteria: Given a GET request with a question as a URL parameter, when it is sent to the Web API, then the Web API receives the question.
Given a GET request without the question parameter, when it is sent, then the Web API does not treat it as a question.
rationale: Role assumed: client developer. The second criterion is an interpretation.

requirement_text: The IDC shall provide objects reliable if they are closer than 100 m to ensure a synchronisation to the ADAS graphic in the IC.
user_story: As a driver assistance engineer, I want the IDC to provide objects reliably when they are closer than 100 m, so that the ADAS graphic in the IC stays synchronized.
technical_task: Deliver objects reliably from the IDC when they are closer than 100 m, to keep the ADAS graphic in the IC synchronized.
acceptance_criteria: Given an object closer than 100 m, when the IDC provides objects, then the object is provided reliably.
Given the provided objects, when the ADAS graphic in the IC is updated, then it is synchronized with them.
rationale: Role assumed: driver assistance engineer. "Reliably" is not measured.

requirement_text: User shall be able to access secure authentication mechanisms for controlling access to databases.
user_story: As a database administrator, I want secure authentication mechanisms for controlling access to databases, so that only authorized users connect.
technical_task: Provide secure authentication for access to the databases.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user with valid credentials, when the user connects to a database, then access is granted.
Given a user without valid credentials, when the user tries to connect, then access is denied.
rationale: Role assumed: database administrator; the requirement says user.

requirement_text: If a primary provider has been entered for that patient they will be selected automatically.
requirement_text_raw: If a primary provider has been entered for that patient  they will be selected automatically.
user_story: As a clerk, I want a primary provider that has been entered for a patient selected automatically, so that I do not select it again.
technical_task: Preselect the primary provider of a patient when one has been entered.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient with a primary provider entered, when the provider selection is shown, then the primary provider is selected automatically.
Given a patient with no primary provider entered, when the provider selection is shown, then nothing is preselected.

requirement_text: System shall notify the recipient user of a connection request and allow them to accept or decline.
user_story: As a user, I want to be notified of a connection request and to accept or decline it, so that I control who connects with me.
technical_task: Notify the recipient of a connection request and offer accept and decline actions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a connection request, when it is sent, then the recipient is notified.
Given a connection request, when the recipient accepts or declines, then the request is accepted or declined.

requirement_text: Performance of making recommendations and updating them in real-time is crucial, requiring seamless processing to ensure users do not notice data processing.
clarification_questions: What response time counts as "seamless" processing for recommendations and updates?

requirement_text: System shall provide car-wise statistics to assist in predicting profitable new car orders.
user_story: As a car dealer, I want car-wise statistics, so that I can predict which new car orders will be profitable.
technical_task: Provide statistics for each car model to help predict profitable new car orders.
acceptance_criteria: Given sales data for cars, when the user opens the statistics, then statistics are shown for each car.
Given the statistics, when the user reviews them, then they can be used to judge which new car orders may be profitable.
rationale: Role assumed: car dealer. The prediction method is not stated.

requirement_text: Such determination should be evident solely by examining the audit log.
rationale: The sentence refers to a determination defined in an earlier sentence that is not given.
clarification_questions: What determination does "Such determination" refer to?
What must the audit log contain to make it evident?

requirement_text: The HCP has authenticated himself or herself in the iTrust Medical Records system (UC2) (UC3).
user_story: As an HCP, I want to be authenticated in the iTrust Medical Records system, so that I can use it (UC2, UC3).
technical_task: Require the HCP to be authenticated in the iTrust Medical Records system before use.
acceptance_criteria: Given an HCP with valid credentials, when the HCP logs in, then the HCP is authenticated.
Given an HCP without valid credentials, when the HCP logs in, then authentication fails.
rationale: Role stated: HCP. The sentence states a precondition of use cases UC2 and UC3.

requirement_text: The concurrency capacity must be able to handle peak scheduling times such as early morning and late afternoon hours.
user_story: As an operations manager, I want the concurrency capacity to handle peak scheduling times such as early morning and late afternoon, so that busy periods work.
technical_task: Dimension the concurrency capacity for peak scheduling times, including early morning and late afternoon hours.
acceptance_criteria: Given a peak scheduling time such as early morning, when many users work at once, then the concurrency capacity handles them.
Given a peak scheduling time such as late afternoon, when many users work at once, then the concurrency capacity handles them.
rationale: Role assumed: operations manager. The number of concurrent users is not given.

requirement_text: The system shall display the created board on the dashboard.
user_story: As a user, I want the board I created shown on the dashboard, so that I can see it right away.
technical_task: Display each created board on the dashboard.
acceptance_criteria: Given a board has been created, when the user opens the dashboard, then the board is displayed.
Given several created boards, when the user opens the dashboard, then each is displayed.

requirement_text: The system shall automatically calculate and display individual balances (IOUs) among group members based on expenses.
user_story: As a group member, I want individual balances (IOUs) calculated and shown automatically from expenses, so that I know who owes what.
technical_task: Calculate and display the balance between each pair of group members from the recorded expenses.
acceptance_criteria: Given expenses recorded in a group, when they are saved, then individual balances (IOUs) among members are calculated.
Given calculated balances, when a member opens the group, then the individual balances are displayed.

requirement_text: BR217, the system sets different parameter sets, not only according to to the user 's selection but also depending on the roof status (opened or closed).
user_story: As a driver, I want BR217 to set different parameter sets depending on my selection and on whether the roof is opened or closed, so that the system matches the roof status.
technical_task: Choose the parameter set in BR217 based on the user's selection and on the roof status (opened or closed).
acceptance_criteria: Given a user selection and the roof opened, when BR217 sets parameters, then it uses the parameter set for that selection with the roof opened.
Given the same user selection and the roof closed, when BR217 sets parameters, then it uses the parameter set for that selection with the roof closed.

requirement_text: Only when memory alignment is permitted, Redundancy Management shall initiate periodic re-synchronization attempts on the FCP virtual group at a 1 second rate.
requirement_text_raw: Only when memory alignment is permitted, Redundancy Management shall [SRS124] initiate periodic re-synchronization attempts on the FCP virtual group at a 1 second rate.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want Redundancy Management to attempt re-synchronization of the FCP virtual group once per second only when memory alignment is permitted, so that recovery is periodic.
technical_task: Start periodic re-synchronization attempts on the FCP virtual group at a 1 second rate, but only when memory alignment is permitted.
acceptance_criteria: Given memory alignment is permitted, when Redundancy Management runs, then it initiates a re-synchronization attempt on the FCP virtual group every 1 second.
Given memory alignment is not permitted, when Redundancy Management runs, then it does not initiate re-synchronization attempts.

requirement_text: The NE shall be configured to automatically enter ISYNC microcode following power on.
requirement_text_raw: The NE shall (3.2.2.3.1) be configured to automatically enter ISYNC microcode following power on.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the NE to enter ISYNC microcode automatically after power on, so that synchronization starts without intervention.
technical_task: Configure the NE to start in ISYNC microcode after power on.
acceptance_criteria: Given the NE is powered on, when power-up completes, then it enters ISYNC microcode automatically.
Given the NE has entered ISYNC microcode, when it is observed, then no manual action was needed.

requirement_text: The application software shall have the capability to reset a permanently failed channel to its initial recovery state.
requirement_text_raw: The application software shall [SRS285] have the capability to reset a permanently failed channel to its initial recovery state.
user_story: As an application developer, I want the application software to reset a permanently failed channel to its initial recovery state, so that the channel can be recovered.
technical_task: Provide the application software with a way to reset a permanently failed channel to the initial recovery state.
acceptance_criteria: Given a permanently failed channel, when the application software resets it, then the channel is in its initial recovery state.
Given a channel that has not permanently failed, when the application software resets it, then the reset is not needed by this requirement.

requirement_text: The minimum processor clock speed shall be 2 GHz.
user_story: As a user, I want a minimum processor clock speed of 2 GHz, so that the system runs well.
technical_task: Specify 2 GHz as the minimum processor clock speed.
acceptance_criteria: Given a processor with a clock speed of 2 GHz or more, when the system is run, then it operates.
Given a processor slower than 2 GHz, when the system is run, then it is not supported.

requirement_text: System shall automatically compress large image files.
user_story: As a user, I want large image files compressed automatically, so that they take less space.
technical_task: Compress large image files automatically.
acceptance_criteria: Given a large image file, when it is saved or uploaded, then it is compressed automatically.
Given a compressed image, when it is compared with the original, then it takes less storage.
rationale: Role assumed: user. What counts as large is not stated.

requirement_text: Passwords must meet specific criteria, including a minimum length of 8 characters, at least one uppercase character, one digit, and one special symbol.
user_story: As a security officer, I want passwords to have at least 8 characters, an uppercase character, a digit and a special symbol, so that they are hard to guess.
technical_task: Enforce a password policy requiring a minimum length of 8 characters, at least one uppercase character, one digit and one special symbol.
acceptance_criteria: Given a password with at least 8 characters, an uppercase character, a digit and a special symbol, when the user sets it, then it is accepted.
Given a password that lacks any of these elements, when the user sets it, then it is rejected.

requirement_text: A list of focused questions and answers with links inside the Get Real site. topics include: money, people, and colleges.
user_story: As a visitor, I want a list of focused questions and answers with links inside the Get Real site, so that I can find answers on money, people and colleges.
technical_task: Add a Q&A list with links inside the Get Real site covering the topics money, people and colleges.
acceptance_criteria: Given the Get Real site, when the visitor opens the Q&A list, then focused questions and answers are shown with links.
Given the Q&A list, when it is reviewed, then it covers the topics money, people and colleges.

requirement_text: The system shall be expected to manage the nursing program curriculum and class/clinical scheduling for a minimum of 5 years.
requirement_text_raw: The system shall be expected to manage the nursing program curriculum and class/clinical scheduling for a minimum of 5 years.'
user_story: As a nursing program administrator, I want the system to manage the curriculum and class and clinical scheduling for at least 5 years, so that the program can plan ahead.
technical_task: Hold and manage the nursing program curriculum and class/clinical scheduling data for a minimum of 5 years.
acceptance_criteria: Given curriculum and scheduling data, when it is stored, then it can be managed for a minimum of 5 years.
Given data from up to 5 years ago, when the administrator opens it, then it is still available.

requirement_text: System shall display reports indicating whether students meet the specified eligibility criteria for exams.
user_story: As an examiner, I want reports showing whether students meet the specified eligibility criteria for exams, so that I know who may sit them.
technical_task: Display reports that show for each student whether the eligibility criteria for exams are met.
acceptance_criteria: Given students and eligibility criteria, when the examiner opens the report, then each student is shown as meeting the criteria or not.
Given a student who meets the criteria, when the report is displayed, then the student is shown as eligible.
rationale: Role assumed: examiner. The criteria are not listed.

requirement_text: All details regarding - not limited to - bottom hold down rails, side ledges for automated handling and cover details shall be designed as specified with EN 50342-2:2007.
user_story: As a mechanical engineer, I want the bottom hold down rails, side ledges for automated handling and cover details designed as specified in EN 50342-2:2007, so that the parts meet the standard.
technical_task: Design the bottom hold down rails, side ledges for automated handling, cover details and other details according to EN 50342-2:2007.
acceptance_criteria: Given the bottom hold down rails, side ledges for automated handling and cover details, when they are reviewed, then they are designed according to EN 50342-2:2007.
Given other details covered by the requirement, when they are reviewed, then they also follow EN 50342-2:2007.
rationale: Role assumed: mechanical engineer. The standard itself is only referenced.

requirement_text: Details of non-functional requirements of the display modules see document .
requirement_text_raw: Details of non-functional requirements of the display modules see document [RD4383].
rationale: The sentence points to a document whose name is missing and states no requirement itself.
clarification_questions: What do the non-functional requirements of the display modules say?
Which document is meant, since the name is missing?

requirement_text: The solution should conform to Entity Authentication.
user_story: As a security officer, I want the solution to conform to Entity Authentication, so that entities are authenticated.
technical_task: Conform to the Entity Authentication requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Given an entity that wants access, when it connects, then it is authenticated.
Given the Entity Authentication requirements, when the solution is reviewed, then it conforms to them.
rationale: Role assumed: security officer. Entity Authentication is only referenced.

requirement_text: The FTSS shall configure each FCP to continue processing if any of the Power-up or Initial BIT tests fail.
requirement_text_raw: The FTSS shall [SRS262] configure each FCP to continue processing if any of the Power-up or Initial BIT tests fail.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the FTSS to configure each FCP to keep processing if any Power-up or Initial BIT test fails, so that a test failure does not halt it.
technical_task: Configure each FCP so that processing continues when a Power-up or Initial BIT test fails.
acceptance_criteria: Given a Power-up test fails on an FCP, when the FCP is configured by the FTSS, then it continues processing.
Given an Initial BIT test fails on an FCP, when the FCP is configured by the FTSS, then it continues processing.

requirement_text: System shall provide a data entry experience comparable to a desktop computer.
clarification_questions: What makes data entry "comparable to a desktop computer" in measurable terms?
Which devices and which entry tasks are compared?

requirement_text: If the 5th ICP fails, the FTSS SW shall ignore the error and allow the NE to continue the synch process and become part of the voting group, if possible.
requirement_text_raw: If the 5th ICP fails, the FTSS SW shall (3.3.2.25) ignore the error and allow the NE to continue the synch process and become part of the voting group, if possible.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the FTSS SW to ignore a failure of the 5th ICP and let the NE continue synchronizing and join the voting group if possible, so that the NE is not blocked.
technical_task: If the 5th ICP fails, ignore the error and allow the NE to continue the synch process and become part of the voting group where possible.
acceptance_criteria: Given the 5th ICP fails, when the FTSS SW handles the failure, then it ignores the error.
Given the error is ignored, when it is possible, then the NE continues the synch process and becomes part of the voting group.

requirement_text: The Camera Dirt Protection closes Camera Covers as requested by CameraApp.
user_story: As a driver, I want the Camera Dirt Protection to close the camera covers when CameraApp requests it, so that the camera is protected from dirt.
technical_task: Close the camera covers in the Camera Dirt Protection whenever CameraApp requests it.
acceptance_criteria: Given CameraApp requests closing, when the request arrives, then the Camera Dirt Protection closes the camera covers.
Given no request from CameraApp, when time passes, then the camera covers are not closed by this function.

requirement_text: Users shall be able to trust and understand the system through its simplicity and transparency.
clarification_questions: What must users be able to understand about the system?

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to grant other users permission to modify scores they own.
user_story: As a score owner, I want to grant other users permission to modify scores I own, so that we can collaborate.
technical_task: Add a permission setting that lets an owner allow other users to modify a score.
acceptance_criteria: Given a score owned by the user, when the owner grants another user permission, then that user can modify the score.
Given a score for which no permission was granted, when another user tries to modify it, then the change is refused.

requirement_text: The system shall enable users to organize ebooks into collections, download for offline reading, and track reading progress.
user_story: As a reader, I want to organize ebooks into collections, download them for offline reading and track my progress, so that I can read comfortably.
technical_task: Provide ebook collections, offline download and reading progress tracking.
acceptance_criteria: Given ebooks, when the user creates a collection and adds them, then they are organized in the collection.
Given an ebook, when the user downloads it and reads it, then it can be read offline and the reading progress is tracked.

requirement_text: System shall maintain consistent functionality across different devices and platforms.
user_story: As a user, I want the same functionality across devices and platforms, so that I get a consistent experience.
technical_task: Keep the system's functions the same on all supported devices and platforms.
acceptance_criteria: Given a function on one supported device, when the same function is used on another supported platform, then it behaves the same.
Given the set of supported platforms, when they are compared, then none lacks a function that another has.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The supported devices are not listed.

requirement_text: The FTSS software and the VxWorks operating system, together shall utilize no more than 3 megabytes of ROM.
requirement_text_raw: The FTSS software and the VxWorks operating system, together shall [SRS193] utilize no more than 3 megabytes of ROM.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the FTSS software and VxWorks together to use no more than 3 megabytes of ROM, so that ROM space is bounded.
technical_task: Limit the combined ROM use of the FTSS software and the VxWorks operating system to 3 megabytes.
acceptance_criteria: Given the FTSS software and the VxWorks operating system, when their ROM use is added together, then it is no more than 3 megabytes.
Given a total above 3 megabytes, when it is evaluated, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: The website shall be capable of supporting 100 000 customers.
requirement_text_raw: The website shall be capable of supporting 100 000 customers.'
user_story: As a business owner, I want the website to support 100 000 customers, so that it serves my customer base.
technical_task: Size the website for 100 000 customers.
acceptance_criteria: Given 100 000 customers, when they use the website, then it supports them.
Given fewer customers, when they use the website, then it supports them.
rationale: Role assumed: business owner. Whether this means registered or concurrent customers is not stated.

requirement_text: Any and all errors associated with obtaining, validating, converting, or storing the sensed data shall be logged as described in subsequent specifications and selected errors shall be reported to the user.
user_story: As a technician, I want errors in obtaining, validating, converting or storing sensed data logged, with selected errors reported to me, so that I can find data problems.
technical_task: Log every error in obtaining, validating, converting or storing sensed data and report selected errors to the user.
acceptance_criteria: Given an error occurs while obtaining, validating, converting or storing sensed data, when it happens, then it is logged.
Given a selected error, when it occurs, then it is reported to the user.
rationale: Role assumed: technician. The selection of errors and the logging format are defined in later specifications.

requirement_text: System provides report generation for delivered goods to facilitate backup and recovery in case of data loss.
user_story: As a store manager, I want a report generated for delivered goods, so that I can back up and recover data after a loss.
technical_task: Generate a report for delivered goods to support backup and recovery.
acceptance_criteria: Given delivered goods, when the user requests a report, then the report is generated.
Given data loss, when the report is used, then it supports recovery of the delivered goods data.

requirement_text: Communication services shall deliver messages in the same order at each member of a virtual group.
requirement_text_raw: Communication services shall [SRS053] deliver messages in the same order at each member of a virtual group.
user_story: As a software developer, I want communication services to deliver messages in the same order to every member of a virtual group, so that all members see the same sequence.
technical_task: Deliver messages to all members of a virtual group in an identical order.
acceptance_criteria: Given several messages sent to a virtual group, when they are delivered, then every member receives them in the same order.
Given two members of a virtual group, when their received orders are compared, then they are identical.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to validate Data Packages to ensure data conformity.
user_story: As a data publisher, I want to validate Data Packages, so that the data conforms.
technical_task: Offer validation of Data Packages against conformity rules.
acceptance_criteria: Given a Data Package that conforms, when the user validates it, then it passes validation.
Given a Data Package that does not conform, when the user validates it, then the validation reports the problem.

requirement_text: System shall provide functionality to create and edit Event records.
user_story: As an organizer, I want to create and edit Event records, so that event information is current.
technical_task: Provide create and edit functions for Event records.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new event, when the user creates an Event record, then it is saved.
Given an existing Event record, when the user edits it, then the changes are saved.

requirement_text: System shall notify the device of issues with the account if the serial key is valid but there are account problems.
user_story: As a user, I want my device told about account problems when my serial key is valid but the account has issues, so that I can fix them.
technical_task: Notify the device of account issues when the serial key is valid but there are account problems.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid serial key and an account with problems, when the system checks the account, then the device is notified of the issues.
Given a valid serial key and an account without problems, when the system checks the account, then no issue notification is sent.

requirement_text: The system shall allow administrators to create "Other" courses/events without a listing fee.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to create "Other" courses or events without a listing fee, so that special offerings can be added free of charge.
technical_task: Allow administrators to create "Other" courses and events with no listing fee.
acceptance_criteria: Given an administrator, when the administrator creates an "Other" course or event, then it is created without a listing fee.
Given an "Other" course or event, when its fees are viewed, then no listing fee is shown.
